_comment: Optional deployment release proposal. Set a new semantic version and notes before deploying; Avenue Guard will DM the configured owner and publish it only after approval. Leave version blank when no automatic proposal is needed.
title: Persistence and uptime reliability
summary: A broad reliability pass for Turso-backed workflows, Discord references, tracking, and public service reporting.
changes: Preserved exact Discord IDs in Turso and repaired legacy IDs that had been rounded
Recovered stale request, sticky, ticket, and release message references from live Discord data
Made tracking totals, weekly rewards, daily summaries, and member resolution restart-safe
Prevented duplicate weekly notices, support DMs, and release approvals after uncertain deliveries
Hardened Turso replica recovery and removed redundant remote pulls from normal writes
Improved request scheduling, auto-close recovery, ticket satisfaction, and support response delivery
Corrected the public current-uptime counter so Discord reconnects no longer reset it
Expanded automated coverage for migrations, 64-bit IDs, recovery, and notification delivery
